## #5 — alvordr — 2010-06-27
<https://www.cheetah3d.com/forum/index.php?threads/5908/post-44205>

Heya.  Try reviewing some of my free tutorials on Cheetah at www.cgvertx.com under Resources.  Meanwhile, add a new material, click on the square to the right of the diffuse (or bump or whatever property of that material you're importing the texture to).  Select 'image' and the click load and find the texture you want to import.
